summary: Bread Financial Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, to announce the launch of an underwritten public offering of depositary shares representing interests in its Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B. The depositary shares have a liquidation preference of $25 per share ($1,000 per Series B share). Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including potential funding of its subsidiary bank and share repurchases. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisors, or unusual terms are disclosed.
